title: Constructibility descends through a finite surjection
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism between schemes of finite type over $k$,
and let $\pi:Y\to X$ be finite and surjective, in the sense of
[def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $\mathcal C(f\pi)$ holds,
then $\mathcal C(f)$ holds, with $\mathcal C$ as in
[def-finrepair-property-c].

proof.text: Fix the finite commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$ in $\mathcal C$, and let $F$ be a constructible $\Lambda$-sheaf on $X_{\Et}$. For any such module sheaf $Q$ (not necessarily constructible), consider the unit $\eta_Q:Q\to\pi_*\pi^*Q$. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-stalk-formula] and [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] to its underlying abelian sheaves. At a geometric point $\bar x$ this identifies $\eta_Q$ with $Q_{\bar x}\to\prod_{\bar y\in Y_{\bar x}}Q_{\bar x}$, $t\mapsto(t)_{\bar y}$: the compatibility with represented germs in the latter citation identifies each component with the identity, rather than merely identifying the source and target groups. The index set is finite and nonempty. Indeed, choose $y$ over $x$ using surjectivity; finiteness gives a finite residue-field extension $\kappa(y)/\kappa(x)$, which embeds over $\kappa(x)$ into the algebraically closed field of $\bar x$, giving a geometric lift. The diagonal is therefore injective. By exactness of geometric stalks [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact], every stalk of $\ker\eta_Q$ is zero. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] to $0\to\ker\eta_Q$ to deduce that the kernel is zero; this proves that $\eta_Q$ is a monomorphism. The module kernel is computed sectionwise: its sections over each etale object are precisely the kernel of the underlying group homomorphism, with the inherited $\Lambda$-action. Thus its underlying zero abelian sheaf is also the zero module sheaf, proving the module monomorphism.

proof.text: The scheme $Y$ is of finite type over $k$: take a finite affine cover $\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ of $X$ by finitely generated $k$-algebras; its inverse images are $\operatorname{Spec}B_i$ with $B_i$ finite as an $A_i$-module. The generators of $A_i$ over $k$ together with a finite set of module generators of $B_i$ generate $B_i$ as a $k$-algebra. This verifies the finite-type source needed in $\mathcal C(f\pi)$ directly from [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put $Q_0=F$. Given constructible $Q_a$, its pullback $\pi^*Q_a$ is constructible by [prop-constructible-pullback], so $G^a=\pi_*\pi^*Q_a$ is constructible by [lem-fin-finite-morphism]. Put $Q_{a+1}=\operatorname{coker}\eta_{Q_a}$; it is constructible by [thm-constructible-serre]. This defines constructible $Q_a,G^a$ for every $a\geq0$ by induction. Define $d^a:G^a\to G^{a+1}$ to be the quotient onto $Q_{a+1}$ followed by its monomorphic unit. Thus $\ker d^a=\operatorname{im}(Q_a\to G^a)$, whereas $\operatorname{im}d^{a-1}=\operatorname{im}(Q_a\to G^a)$ for $a>0$, since $G^{a-1}\to Q_a$ is an epimorphism. For $a=0$ the same kernel is the image of $F$. Consequently $d^{a+1}d^a=0$ and $0\to F\to G^0\to G^1\to\cdots$ is exact. Extend $G^\bullet$ by zero in negative degrees; the augmentation $F[0]\to G^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: For each $a$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-spectral-sequence] to $Y\xrightarrow{\pi}X\xrightarrow f S$ and the constructible module sheaf $\pi^*Q_a$. Its page is $E_2^{b,q}=R^bf_*(R^q\pi_*(\pi^*Q_a))$. By [lem-fin-finite-morphism], the rows $q>0$ vanish. In the remaining row there are no incoming or outgoing differentials from page two on. The finite filtration of the degree-$b$ abutment supplied by the cited spectral sequence has a single nonzero graded piece, $E_2^{b,0}$; hence $R^bf_*G^a\cong R^b(f\pi)_*(\pi^*Q_a)$ for every $b\geq0$. Only vanishing for the particular constructible sheaves $\pi^*Q_a$ has been used; no assertion of exactness of $\pi_*$ on arbitrary sheaves is taken from [lem-fin-finite-morphism].

source.place: Proof, third paragraph: composition spectral sequence, with the row-collapse argument written out

proof.text: Work in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and $\Mod(S_{\Et},\Lambda)$, which are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian]; the source has enough injectives by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. The functor $f_*$ is additive and left exact on these module categories by [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Apply [lem-sp-cartan-eilenberg-exists] to the nonnegative complex $G^\bullet$ of step 2. Apply [thm-sp-if-e1] to this Cartan--Eilenberg resolution and $v=f_*$, exchanging its indices $(r,s)=(b,a)$. This gives $E_1^{a,b}=R^bf_*G^a\Longrightarrow\mathcal H^{a+b}(Rf_*G^\bullet)$ for $a,b\geq0$. Since step 2 identifies $G^\bullet$ with $F[0]$ in the derived category, the derived functor of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] identifies the abutment with $R^{a+b}f_*F$. The differential convention after exchanging indices is $d_r:E_r^{a,b}\to E_r^{a+r,b-r+1}$.

proof.text: By the hypothesis $\mathcal C(f\pi)$, interpreted exactly as [def-finrepair-property-c], the sheaves $R^b(f\pi)_*(\pi^*Q_a)$ are constructible for all $a,b\geq0$, since every $\pi^*Q_a$ is constructible. By the isomorphisms of step 3, all the terms of the $E_1$ page of step 4 are therefore constructible.

source.place: Proof, fourth paragraph: use of the hypothesis

proof.text: Use [thm-constructible-serre] to pass inductively from one constructible page to the next: the kernel of each differential and its image are constructible (the image is the kernel of its cokernel), and the quotient of the kernel by the incoming image is constructible by the cokernel clause. Outside $a,b\geq0$ every term is zero. At $(a,b)$ an incoming differential has source $(a-r,b+r-1)$ and an outgoing one has target $(a+r,b-r+1)$; both vanish when $r>\max(a,b+1)$, so the stable term is constructible. The convergence assertion of [thm-sp-if-e1], with the conventions [def-sp-convergence], gives the abutment filtration; here it is finite, because in degree $n$ the first-quadrant total complex and its filtration have only the summands $a+b=n$ with $0\leq a\leq n$. Thus $R^nf_*F$ has a finite filtration whose quotients are the constructible $E_\infty^{a,n-a}$. Starting with its zero final step and using the extension clause of [thm-constructible-serre] repeatedly shows that $R^nf_*F$ is constructible. Since $F$ and $n\geq0$ were arbitrary, this is $\mathcal C(f)$. The proof uses only finitely many filtration pieces in each degree and asserts no uniform vanishing bound.
